description:
Backlog helps you save ideas, tasks, and things you want to revisit without interrupting your conversation.

Simply ask ChatGPT to add something to your backlog. You can later search, browse, update, complete, or remove saved items directly from any conversation.

Use Backlog for project ideas, side projects, things to research later, technical tasks, reminders-to-self, or anything worth keeping for another day.

No boards to organize. No forms to fill out. Just keep talking.
